dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #Ya-ho! Hey there, {NICKNAME}. Here's your "Dance Party Captain of the Guard," reporting in!

choices.text: You've really gone all out this time, Mualani!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hehe, wasn't it a pleasant surprise to see one of your friends from Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: If we had to do the math on this sequence of events... I guess we have Xilonen and Varesa to thank in the end?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: They have a friend in Mondstadt who sent a postcard with Barbara drawn on it to Nepecha...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Xilonen handed me the card, and I did some asking around, which led me to finding this amazing dancer from Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Once I knew, I just had to invite her over!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Otherwise, I'd never be able to shake the feeling that we were missing a crucial piece in our dance party puzzle!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: We've had friends from the Knights of Favonius visit previously. They're bold and courageous, and they got along great with us People of the Springs.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: It just so happened that I met a knight I had made friends with back then, and got them to send a letter through the Adventurers' Guild, which was delivered to Barbara.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Still, if we hadn't only just invited Nilou over from Sumeru and didn't have a million and one things left to set up...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I would've gone to Mondstadt myself. I mean, that would've been the earnest thing to do, right?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Not to mention how I've been curious about Mondstadt for some time now. It seems like tons of fun!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Anyway, I'm totally adding it to my list of tour destinations!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: After this dance party's over, I'll need to help Amina supervise the training of our new warriors...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: And if all goes to plan, I can continue touring once that's over.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Look out now. You never know when I'll show up in a place both familiar yet unexpected, and surprise you!

choices.text: I almost thought I'd come to the wrong studio.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hmm? Is your spirit stirred to dance? Go on then! Show 'em what you've got!
